name: zurl
description: Manage a Zurl short link service — create, update, delete, search, and list short URLs, and fetch URL metadata. Trigger whenever the user asks to "shorten this link", "generate a short URL", "create a short link", "短链接", "缩短", "短链", manage short links, or pastes a long URL and asks to make it shorter. Do NOT skip this skill just because the user didn't explicitly say "短链接" or "short URL" — even "帮我缩短这个链接" or "把这个 网址变短" should trigger it. Any request involving URL shortening, short link management, or batch URL operations should use this skill.
